subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir demonstrated remarkable composure during the battle with the Medusa, repeatedly deflecting its petrifying gaze by shoving an ice mirror in her face, and later delivered a devastating series of blows that left the first Earth Elemental severely wounded.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast magical missiles that ended the Medusa's life, used a mesmerizing pattern to incapacitate the first Earth Elemental, unleashed a massive fire explosion against the third elemental, and later shattered the spell's hold on the first elemental.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum, the party's cleric, volunteered to place the Ruby spell gem into the great menhir to hallow the temple, unleashed a powerful divine spell through his crossbow to destroy the second Earth Elemental, and provided ranged support during the third battle.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin engaged the second and third Earth Elementals directly with his glowing sword Dawnbringer, intercepted a critical attack on Zalthir, struck the third elemental with devastating precision, and stood firm against crushing blows while the party coordinated their final assault.

subject: Galeb Duhr
fact: The Galeb Duhr are ancient stone guardians of the temple, bound by Ogrémoch's corruption to serve as inert sentinels; they speak only after their elemental oppressors are freed, and each freed guardian reveals that more brothers remain enslaved.

subject: Medusa
fact: The Medusa was a serpentine horror whose petrifying gaze caused a harrowing battle; its still serpentine hair lay defeated after being reflected back upon itself by an ice mirror, and its remains were tasted by Glabbagool.

subject: Earth Elemental (first)
fact: The first Earth Elemental emerged from the temple wall with hostile intent, was incapacitated by Daz's mesmerizing pattern, and was reduced to rubble after Zalthir's devastating blows and Grygum's divine light.

subject: Earth Elemental (second)
fact: The second Earth Elemental attacked with focus on Zalthir, was weakened by Grygum's radiant bolts and Daz's necrotic magic, and was destroyed when Grygum channeled divine energy through his crossbow to pierce its stony hide.

subject: Earth Elemental (third)
fact: The third Earth Elemental emerged as the second fell, struck Thorin with crushing blows, was worn down by Daz's fiery rays and Grygum's support, and was shattered into fragments by Zalthir's enhanced strike.

subject: Galeb Duhr (first)
fact: The first Galeb Duhr appeared after the first elemental fell, spoke in measured tones, explained it had been freed from Ogrémoch's control, and revealed that its brothers remained bound until all elementals were destroyed.

subject: Galeb Duhr (second)
fact: The second Galeb Duhr appeared as the second elemental crumbled, spoke to the party, and confirmed the pattern: freedom comes only after each elemental is slain, and the temple's corruption persists until all guardians are liberated.

subject: Galeb Duhr (third)
fact: The third Galeb Duhr materialized after the third elemental was destroyed, indicating that the party's cleansing of the temple is incomplete and that more guardians remain bound beneath the stone.

subject: Ruby spell gem
fact: The Ruby spell gem, provided by Gerdig Katfinger, was placed by Grygum into the great menhir in the temple's center to hallow the sacred site and initiate its cleansing from Ogrémoch's Bane.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is Thorin's glowing magical sword, used to engage Earth Elementals directly, intercept attacks, and deliver precise, devastating strikes that cut deep into their rocky forms.

subject: Five exquisite dresses made of spider silk and shaped by drow magic
fact: These dresses, discovered in the Medusa's lair, are worth a considerable fortune in the markets of the Underdark and were crafted using drow magic, hinting at deeper ties to the subterranean civilizations.

subject: Ancient temple
fact: The ancient temple is a sacred site corrupted by Ogrémoch's Bane, an evil force from the elemental plane of earth; its walls contain humanoid shapes, menhirs with empty sockets, and multiple hidden elemental and Galeb Duhr guardians.

subject: Temple's center (menhir)
fact: The great menhir at the temple's center holds the Ruby spell gem placed by Grygum; its sockets glow when activated and are central to the ritual of hallowing and cleansing the temple from Ogrémoch's corruption.

subject: Northern wall
fact: The northern wall of the temple is a point of emergence for the second Earth Elemental, suggesting structural weaknesses or hidden portals tied to the elemental corruption.

subject: Hallowing the temple
fact: The party's act of placing the Ruby spell gem into the menhir initiated the ritual to cleanse the temple of Ogrémoch's Bane, triggering the release of bound Galeb Duhr guardians and the awakening of Earth Elementals.

subject: Defeating the Medusa
fact: The party's victory over the Medusa allowed them to search her lair, recover the spider-silk dresses, and gain access to the deeper layers of the temple, where Ogrémoch's corruption lay hidden.

subject: Ogrémoch's Bane
fact: Ogrémoch's Bane is an evil force from the elemental plane of earth that has infected the temple, preventing Galeb Duhr guardians from performing their sacred duty; its full nature and origin remain unknown, and its defeat requires freeing all guardians.

subject: Freed Galeb Duhr
fact: Each freed Galeb Duhr confirms that more brothers remain bound; the party's work is incomplete, and the temple's true cleansing requires the destruction of all Earth Elementals and the liberation of every guardian.

subject: Glabbagool's delight
fact: Glabbagool, the intelligent gelatinous cube, expressed unusual delight at tasting the Medusa's remains and noted the party provided excellent dietary flavoring; its motives and long-term relationship with the party remain ambiguous.

subject: session date
fact: The events of this chapter occurred during the party's current expedition into the Underdark, following their defeat of the Medusa and preceding any known rest period.
